object_description: two rotated eight-level volumes enclosing a dense central heart
design_condition: The built masses are concentrated west of the site, leaving the eastern perimeter open for walks, sports, and landscape, while establishing an axial dialogue with neighbouring monumental buildings.

positive.statement: The urban and morphological concept establishes an equivalent relationship with the existing prison and a striking dialogue with the neighbouring building.

position.rationale: Anchored at the open eastern perimeter where the built masses engage the surrounding monumental context.

positive.statement: The concentration of the built masses frees a significant surface area of the site.

position.rationale: Dense sampled masses occupy the western portion, leaving a visibly open eastern site surface.

positive.statement: The formal system connects the essential elements with great consistency and supports the proper functioning of the establishment.

position.rationale: Central diagonal organization and repeated levels visibly connect the sampled volumes.

positive.statement: The cellular spaces are carefully considered, freed from parasitic accessories, and opened unhindered toward the sky and landscape.

position.rationale: Interior cellular zones are approximated around the central voids and upper visible levels.

negative.statement: The landscaped treatment of the open site is insufficiently developed, and the necessary privacy between walks is difficult to achieve.

position.target: landscaped treatment of the open site
position.rationale: The open eastern and southern perimeter provides the constrained anchor for landscape and privacy concerns.

negative.statement: The density of activity and concentration of people generated by the system are not considered credible.

position.target: density of activity and concentration of people
position.rationale: Anchored within the visibly concentrated western building mass rather than the open perimeter.

negative.statement: The provision of natural light to the lower floors is not convincing.

position.target: natural light to the lower floors
position.rationale: Lower-level concern is placed on the sampled lower envelope surrounding the central cellular organization.

negative.statement: The guards and prisoners would be confined within a perfectly controlled but oppressive architectural system.

position.rationale: The judgment concerns the overall institutional system rather than one geometrically isolatable feature.

negative.statement: The high number of floors would create significant difficulties for prisoner movement and transfers.

position.rationale: Repeated horizontal bands across the elevations visibly establish the tall multi-level building mass.

negative.statement: The complexity of the cellular facades makes the construction cost significantly higher than the target.

position.rationale: Dense repeated facade points are visible along the western and opposing elevation edges.

negative.statement: The built density makes phased construction of the cellular building problematic.

position.rationale: The compact western mass is visibly dense, providing the anchor for phased-construction concerns.
